{"requirements": [
    {"id": 1, "text": "The goal of the game is to grow the length of the snake by making the snake eat food until it fills the entire board."},
    {"id": 2, "text": "The snake eats food when it touches the food (namely every time the snake passes over food on the board)."},
    {"id": 3, "text": "Every time the snake eats a piece of food, its body grows by one block which gets attached to the end of the body."},
    {"id": 4, "text": "The snake must not touch a board side."},
    {"id": 5, "text": "The game is over as soon as the snake's body is touched."},
    {"id": 6, "text": "The game board consists of k x k blocks, where k shall be given as input by the user. Every block, including the food and body blocks of the snake, shall have a size such that there are enough blocks to play the game correctly."},
    {"id": 7, "text": "When the game starts, the board is initialised with a snake and a piece of food. It shall be represented as a single green block, positioned at the bottom left square of the board. The initial direction shall be up. The other is represented as a single red block placed at a random position on the board."},
    {"id": 8, "text": "The snake shall be moved by pressing up, down, right, or left on the keyboard."},
    {"id": 9, "text": "Every time the snake eats a piece of food, a new one shall appear."},
    {"id": 10, "text": "Every time the snake eats a piece of food, its speed shall increase by 10 milliseconds."},
    {"id": 11, "text": "The user can set the difficulty to easy or hard. If the user selects easy, the snake shall initially move with a speed of 0.5 blocks per second."},
    {"id": 12, "text": "After the snake has eaten many pieces of food, a blue bonus piece of food shall appear. When the snake eats that piece, three blocks shall be attached to the snake's body."},
    {"id": 13, "text": "Sometimes, a golden bonus block shall appear additionally to the food block. If the snake eats the bonus block, its speed shall decrease by 5%."},
    {"id": 14, "text": "If the user presses p on the keyboard, the game shall pause until the user presses q again."}
]}
